title: Fusion techniques of time frequency-based images to predict the outcome of rTMS depression therapy
abstract: arXiv:2610.00380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Depression is a mental condition that can lead to suicide and self-harm. Predicting the outcome of depression treatment is one of the most difficult tasks for clinicians. Among various treatment options, repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) is a widely used non-invasive method. Predicting rTMS response using Electroencephalogram (EEG) data is difficult because of high inter-subject variability and limited features from single-domain analysis. We introduce two fusion techniques, montage and blending, to overcome these limitations and extract richer features from EEG-derived Time-Frequency (TF) images. translated_abstract: 抑郁症是一种可能导致自杀和自伤的精神疾病。预测抑郁症治疗结果是临床医生面临的最困难的任务之一。在各种治疗方案中，重复经颅磁刺激是一种广泛使用的无创治疗方法。由于被试间的高变异性和单域分析的特征有限，使用脑电图（EEG）数据预测rTMS的治疗反应非常困难。我们引入了两种融合技术——蒙太奇（montage）和混合（blending），以克服这些限制，并从EEG衍生的时频（TF）图像中提取更丰富的特征。随后，我们提出了一个在融合时频表示上训练的轻量级自定义卷积神经网络（CNN）。我们使用了一个包含15名患者的主要数据集和一个包含46名患者的次要数据集。我们进行了两组实验。第一组采用分段级别的10折交叉验证。在此设置中，来自……（摘要内容截断）
tldr: 该研究提出蒙太奇和混合两种EEG时频图像融合技术，结合轻量级卷积神经网络，有效预测抑郁症患者对rTMS治疗的反应。
en_tdlr: This study proposes two fusion techniques, montage and blending, for EEG-derived time-frequency images, combined with a lightweight custom CNN to effectively predict depression patients' response to rTMS therapy.
